app.title: Bead to Scarf
app.subtitle: Turn your fused-bead art into a knitted scarf

upload.title: Upload a photo of your bead art
upload.hint: Drag & drop, click to choose, or paste an image (Ctrl/⌘+V).
upload.tips: Tip: shoot straight from above in even light, with the whole piece in frame.
upload.unsupported: This format can't be read by the browser (e.g. HEIC). Please convert to JPG or PNG.
upload.cropHint: Drag the box so it hugs the edges of the beads. Use rotation to straighten the rows.
upload.oneClickHint: Lazy mode — crops, pixelizes, tidies and knits automatically. You can still go back and tweak any step.
upload.busyBg: The background looks busy. For the best result, retake the photo on a solid plain background (white paper or the pegboard). You can also crop tightly or fix the background in the editor.
upload.autoFailed: Auto mode couldn’t finish — please try the steps manually.

pixelize.title: Pixelize
pixelize.hint: Set how many beads wide and tall your piece is. Each cell is matched to the nearest bead colour.
pixelize.detectFailed: Couldn't detect the bead grid — please enter it manually.
pixelize.overwrite: This will replace your edited pattern. Continue?
pixelize.autoDoneGuess: Auto: couldn’t see the bead grid, guessed {{w}} × {{h}} — please check. {{n}} colours.
pixelize.removeEnclosed: Also remove background inside the motif
pixelize.bgHint: Leftover background? Fix it in the next step with the 🪄 magic eraser.
pixelize.autoHint: Finds the bead grid, the number of colours and the background for you.

edit.cleanHint: Remove colours that are not used
edit.noGrid: No pattern yet — start by uploading a photo.

toolHints.pencil: Click or drag to place beads · brush size 1–3
toolHints.eraser: Click or drag to remove beads
toolHints.fill: Click to fill a connected area
toolHints.picker: Click a bead to pick its colour
toolHints.replace: Click a bead to replace that colour everywhere
toolHints.wand: Click an area to erase everything connected of that colour (great for background)

edit.autoTidyHint: Removes leftover background around the edge and stray single beads.
edit.railTip: Tip: the 🪄 magic eraser wipes out a whole background area in one click.

chart.gaugeHint: Knit stitches are wider than they are tall, so the motif gets extra rows to keep its shape. Knit a swatch to measure your own gauge.
chart.readNote: Row 1 is at the bottom. Read right-side (odd) rows right → left and wrong-side (even) rows left → right. Dots mark purl-textured edge stitches.
chart.tipIntarsia: Tip: with many colours, intarsia or duplicate stitch (embroidering the motif afterwards) is easier than stranded colourwork.
chart.tipStranded: Tip: with few colours this works well as stranded (Fair Isle) colourwork, or intarsia for large blocks.
chart.autoHint: Picks a matching main yarn and a classic layout from your defaults.
chart.legendHint: click a colour or name to change it to the yarn you bought.
chart.stackWide: Stack wide patterns along the scarf

scarf.title: Scarf preview
scarf.hint: A textured preview of your scarf, knitted stitch by stitch.
scarf.newConfirm: Start a new project? Your current pattern will be cleared.
scarf.curlWarn: Plain stockinette with no edge rolls up into a sausage!
scarf.curlSome: A narrow edge only partly stops the curling.
scarf.curlFine: The edge stitch keeps this scarf flat.
scarf.curlForced: This is how plain stockinette rolls up without an edge pattern.
scarf.playHint: Press anywhere on the scarf and drag to pick it up and move it around.

settings.title: Settings
settings.bgTooLarge: That image is too large to save. Try a smaller one.

palette.title: Palette
palette.name: Name
palette.empty: No colours yet — add some below.
palette.createHint: ＋ makes your own palette (e.g. only the beads you own).

machine.hint: Help the machine: hold SPACE or just type anything to knit · ← → push the carriage · or drag it.

physics.title: Tune how it feels
physics.hint: Drag the scarf while adjusting — changes apply instantly and are remembered. Copy the values and send them over to make them the default.
physics.handSpanHint: How much of the scarf your hand holds. Bigger = more of it moves together.
physics.holdHint: How firmly the held area follows your hand.
physics.followHint: How fast the scarf catches up with the cursor. Lower = calmer.
physics.stiffnessHint: How much the fabric resists bending.
physics.tableDampingHint: Higher = keeps sliding after you let go; lower = more friction.
physics.airDampingHint: How freely the lifted part swings.
physics.smoothingHint: Evens out wiggles along the scarf.
physics.liftHeightHint: How high the held part rises off the table.
physics.iterationsHint: Solver passes per frame. More = stiffer, a bit slower.
